name: Product catalog and variant management
description: The store must manage product listings, variants, pricing, and descriptions in a structured way so customers see accurate information and staff can maintain inventory correctly.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about products, SKUs, or variants.
Developer mentions product catalog management.
Developer discusses pricing or listing accuracy.

name: Order management and fulfillment flow
description: The system must support order intake, status updates, packing, shipping, and customer communication across the fulfillment workflow.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks how orders are processed and shipped.
Developer mentions order status or fulfillment tracking.
Developer discusses customer communication around delivery.

name: Inventory and stock synchronization
description: The business needs accurate stock counts, low-stock alerts, and inventory control across product variants and channels.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about inventory, stock, or reorder triggers.
Developer mentions stock accuracy across channels.
Developer discusses low-stock or oversell risk.

name: Payments, returns, and refunds
description: The system must support secure payment processing, return handling, and refund workflows with clear accounting outcomes.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about payment methods or currency.
Developer mentions returns or refunds.
Developer discusses settlement or reconciliation.

name: Customer accounts and order history
description: The business may need customer accounts, saved addresses, and order history to support repeat business and support operations.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about customer accounts or saved profiles.
Developer mentions order history or support.
Developer discusses loyalty or repeat purchase behavior.

name: Shipping and logistics coordination
description: The business needs shipping carrier details, address accuracy, and delivery coordination so fulfillment keeps moving without delays or errors.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about delivery or shipping operations.
Developer mentions carriers or address validation.
Developer discusses order dispatch or fulfillment issues.

name: Reporting and business visibility
description: The owner needs accurate sales, conversion, inventory, and operational reporting so choices are based on real data rather than guesswork.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about dashboards or sales reporting.
Developer mentions conversion, stock movement, or fulfillment KPIs.
Developer discusses operational visibility for management.

name: Marketing and promotions workflow
description: The business may need product promotions, coupon logic, and campaign tracking to support acquisition and retention.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about discounts or coupons.
Developer mentions campaign tracking or promotions.
Developer discusses customer acquisition or retention.

name: Operational constraints and integration needs
description: The solution must fit real-world business complexity such as marketplace connections, existing accounting tools, and low-friction warehouse operations.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about current tools or integrations.
Developer mentions staff adoption or process disruption.
Developer discusses operational realities like low staff capacity or system dependencies.
